description: This is an HTML source file that implements a web-based database viewer interface with embedded CSS and JavaScript functions for dynamic data loading, UI interactions, and rendering database contents.

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches list of databases and populates the sidebar with database items.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes the database list by reloading from server and resets UI state.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Expands or collapses the database to show its tables, and loads the table data if expanded.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Requests list of tables for a selected database and updates the table list in UI.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Fetches data for a specific table and renders it in a table format.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Generates HTML for a data table given the dataset.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Creates cell HTML with special handling for objects, long text, and nulls.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Expands or collapses a cell to show full content if truncated or collapsed.
